description: This class defines a custom JSP tag 'ShopProductPriceFormatTag' that formats the price of a product with appropriate currency display, utilizing services for pricing and product utilities, and rendering the formatted price in JSP pages.

classes.name: ShopProductPriceFormatTag
classes.description: A custom JSP tag class that formats product prices for display, optionally considering a specific currency.

methods.name: doStartTagInternal
methods.description: Initializes dependencies if not autowired, retrieves store information from request, formats the price based on currency if provided, and outputs the formatted price.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Completes processing of the tag, indicates to continue processing the page.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the BigDecimal value representing the price.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the current BigDecimal value of the price.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Returns the assigned Currency object for formatting.

methods.name: setCurrency
methods.description: Sets the Currency object used for price formatting.
